text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's gotten her groove back! But
which of them will be
blessed by the
goddess of victory?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wahaaah! You couldn't hit a barn with that
aim! Hraaah! Take thiiiis!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?! Get back here! How about this then!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen unleashes a flurry of
attacks! Can Gold Ship evade
them all?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho! Ha! Kyaaah! No sweat! Come on, that
all you got?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm empty?
Where's the refill station?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Trying to run now?! Get back here!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Goooo! Yeah! Go, go, go!
Waaah! Get out
of there! Keep running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You think you can take me on in a
battle of stamina? Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible speed! Mejiro McQueen has
broken away in an instant!
She's already
back with a refilled water cartridge!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Not good enough! I'm going to win!)

text_block_list.name: McQueen & Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaaah!
Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The turbulent final match is over. And as
the sun sets, the barbeque
celebration
begins.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That sauce smells great! It looks
really good!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hmm. ♪ Hm! ...Mmm hm hmm!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, still being quiet like you promised?
Hehehe, too bad you didn't
win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Behaving yourself doesn't mean you can't
speak. Though if I must
say...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's become so peaceful without you
making a fuss like normal. Haha! I
think I'll
finally be able to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what now? I'll have no complaints from
you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hmm! Hmhmm ...Mhm, hm, hm,
hmmm hm hm!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I didn't understand a bit of that... Hey,
what do you have there? No! I
don't want
any! Don't touch my food with that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Maruzen. So this is where you were.
Mind if I stand here with
you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, go right ahead! You're very welcome.
Look, isn't the sunset
beautiful? ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wooow... It really is! Beautiful, and such
stunning colors... It kind of
makes me sad
that today's almost over.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the more fun we have, the quicker
time flies by... I have to say,
I'm a teensy
bit sad too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This was all so... I mean, I couldn't even
have imagined how much fun
this would
be.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You really enjoyed it then?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I sure did! You were so amazing in our
water gun fight, Chiyo! I was
struggling so
hard my face must've been white with fear!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Having someone who could stand up and
give me a serious
challenge... made me so
happy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
This turned out to be the best
summer because of you.
I'm never going to
forget this experience!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gasp... No! I should be thanking you! Getting to participate together was just such a blast!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget this either! The way you
really put your heart into our
fight, or the
excitement this summer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I'm completely exhausted... But,
hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to keep this vow of
silence, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Really? Guess we can talk about the
squid ministers' rebellion
then! Their
unrestrained ambition led them to try to
take the throne—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Noisy nonsense is still forbidden. Just
speak about normal things. It's
outright
impossible trying to understand you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But this time...
I realized something about
you. I suppose even you
have some good
qualities.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho? So you finally see how amazing I
really am? Okay, lay it on me.
Keep those
compliments coming!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't be so full of yourself.
But...
you're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Though I say this sparingly... you have my
gratitude. There was some
hardship
involved, but I'm glad to have played with
you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoooa! You feeling okay? One
minute you're all dejected,
but now I don't
know what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm perfectly fine.
I was only saying what's
on my mind. Weren't you
the one who was
being unusually persistent?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I was only like that 'cause you looked so
dang determined to not have
fun! All that
observing I did, and you didn't molt or
hibernate once.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone like that just makes me
want to poke 'em. It's no fun
to just leave
you alone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What kind of reason is that? Can you at
least try to understand what
it's like to be
the one poked?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(But... doesn't that mean she was paying
attention to me because
something
seemed off?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(If she hadn't suddenly said she was
bored... If I hadn't lost it with her

attitude... I'd probably still be...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, how silly. It's useless trying to
reason what your true intentions ever are.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you just see that sea monster?!
We should go exchange
business
cards—oh, right. I'm supposed to keep it
down...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You only have to stay quiet until the sun
finishes setting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But don't budge until then. Stay here,
just
like this...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You sure that's long enough? You
won after all. There's no
telling what I'll
get up to after this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's fine... It's summer after all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's summer got to do with it? Geez,
now I'm talking like you!
You're good...
Really good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, hey, stop moving! Ahahaha!
